producer.dispatch: The schedule invokes the Lambda irpt-holdings-refresh-lambda (refresh_dispatch.lambda_handler, source infra/aws/lambda/investor-reporting/holdings_refresh/refresh_dispatch.py), which sends one AWS-RunShellScript SSM command per firm to the daily-runner host; each command fetches that firm's standalone bundle, verifies SHA256SUMS, and runs holdings_snapshot.py --firms <firm> --upload.

schedule.name: irpt-holdings-snapshot
schedule.target: Lambda irpt-holdings-refresh-lambda (account id redacted; scheduler group default)

release_path.deploy_tool: bash .tools/safe-deploy.sh --mint-bundle <irpt_holdings_49f|irpt_holdings_cot|irpt_holdings_inf> (execs safe_deploy_core.py; mint_bundle uploads with stamp metadata and verifies the ETag and the stamp echoed on head-object)
release_path.rollback: Copy the prior S3 object version of the same key back over it (copy-object with CopySource VersionId, the prior VersionId read by list-object-versions on that one key), confirm head-object ETag equals the prior version's ETag; the next scheduled fire then serves it. The manifest target per firm is in rollback_by_manifest_version.

s71_reconciliation.reading: The four absent files (infra/logic/registry feeds.json, firm_pages.json, legacy_addresses.json, platinum_destinations.json) are OPTIONAL_REGISTRY_FILES in lib/opal_naming.py, which load_registry reads as None when absent, so the runner completes; the probe records the open attempt. Each firm's 2026-10-13 scheduled SSM fire reads Success and its current/manifest.json or publish_refusal.json LastModified falls after the bundle's LastModified, so the fires wrote records; this does not establish the runtime path beyond those records.
